lines.text: Nine dots. How many circles pass through at least three of them?
lines.caption: Nine dots. How many circles pass through at least three of them?

lines.text: Lots of kids say seventy-six. But it's much smaller!
lines.caption: Lots of kids say seventy-six. But it's much smaller!

lines.text: Nine dots in a grid. How many different circles pass through at least three?
lines.caption: Nine dots in a grid. How many different circles pass through at least three?

lines.text: Groups of three give seventy-six. But look at this square.
lines.caption: Groups of three give seventy-six. But look at this square.

lines.text: Leave out any corner. The other three make the SAME circle!
lines.caption: Leave out any corner. The other three make the SAME circle!

lines.text: So that circle was counted four times. There are fourteen like it.
lines.caption: So that circle was counted four times. There are fourteen like it.

lines.text: Take away three extra copies of each. Fourteen times three is forty-two.
lines.caption: Take away three extra copies of each. Fourteen times three is forty-two.

lines.text: The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
